PRODUCT_NAME: Field Upgradeable Interface Module for Cubis, 25-pin RS232 (for connection of Cubis accessory equipment; same as IR option)
DESCRIPTION:
Interface Modules for connection of Cubis series balances. Scales in the Cubis series have at least two data interface ports that are used to output measurement values, calculated values and parameter settings to printers, PCs or checkweighing displays. These interfaces can also be used to enter control commands (e.g. key confirmations via a foot switch) or alphanumeric inputs (e.g. via a
barcode scanner).

This Sartorius radio interface enables wireless data communication between a Sartorius scale and a remote device. The interface is powered by Bluetooth wireless technology. The remote device can be a Sartorius printer, like the YDP10BT-0CE (Spectrum Cat. No. 646-10714), or a PC. This feature makes conventional data connection cables between two data interfaces (RS-232) superfluous.

Connections Options:
• 646-10711: Verifiable data printer (RS232/25-pin)
• 646-10714: Verifiable data printer with Bluetooth data transmission (Bluetooth)
• 446-27661: 3-segment display, Red - Green - Red, for plusminus weighing, including T connector (RS232/25-pin)
• 646-10669: Extra display, LCD, number size 13 mm, backlit (RS232/25-pin, RS232/9-pin+PS2)
• 446-28534: Infrared sensor for touchless function triggering (e.g. draft shield control) (RS232/25-pin)
• 446-27640: Hand switch for printing, taring, or to use function keys; Selection via menu, including T connector (RS232/25-pin)
• 446-27634: Foot switch for printing, taring, or to use function keys; selection via menu, including T connector (RS232/25-pin)
• 446-27649: Foot switch, including T connector; for all ME models and SE2 (RS232/25-pin)

Additional connection options for interfacing to optional Sartorius ports:
• PC/Laptop (via Sartorius accessory cable) (RS232/25-pin, RS232/9-pin+PS2, Bluetooth)
• PC keyboard to PS2 port (RS232/9-pin+PS2)

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: SP Wilmad-LabGlass ZrO2 Rotor, 4 mm Bruker MAS Probe
PRODUCT_NAME: SP Wilmad-LabGlass ZrO2 Rotor, 4 mm Bruker MAS Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Manufactured from the highest purity Zirconia, our MAS Rotors provide the NMR spectroscopist with the ultimate alternative for analysis of solid samples; the need to solvate is eliminated. They are available for most present solid state NMR spectrometers. Wilmads MAS Rotors are carefully examined for material irregularities by optical methods before and after the precision machining process. Without over-spinning, each rotor is spin tested to only the highest specified spinning speed. Overspin testing, a common practice with some rotor brands, can actually damage the rotor prior to use. High precision (which becomes a necessity for proper spinning performance) is maintained in the manufacture of the end caps. Most caps are fitted with O-rings for better sealing; some have axial holes for venting.

Advantages of Zirconia Rotors:
• Most homogeneous ceramic material structure.
• Wilmads Zirconia Rotor Body has higher strength (1,000 MPa, greater than Si3N4).
• Highest spinning speed
• High precision superior finish (0.05 µ mirror gloss).

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

DESCRIPTION: Scroll Vacuum Pumps are dry pumps that use two spiral scrolls to compress air and vapors and move them toward the exhaust. While they can have higher up-front costs, the lifetime operation costs are much lower because they don’t require oil and very little maintenance is needed. Scroll pumps handle water vapor better than most types of pumps and make significantly less noise during operation. Silencer for Labconco Scroll Vacuum Pumps combines filtration efficiency with noise reduction. Prevents tip seal dust from contaminating environment. Silences irritating pump exhaust noise. Sound absorbent element is replaceable. PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 6 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Two Service Fixtures and One GFCI Duplex, Extra Deep 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 6 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Two Service Fixtures and One GFCI Duplex, Extra Deep 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.
• One pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle (two on 8 ft. models only)

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Echo Hood, No Fixtures, Solid Walls, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood
• Work Surface
• Base Cabinet or Stand

Options Available Include
• HEPA filter
• Sash Opening Wing Reduction Kits
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Compliance
• SEFA 9, DHIII, SEFA 8, Cabinet Surface Finish Tests, Modified ASHRAE 110, ANSI Z9.5-2011, AFNOR NF-X 15-211, ASTM E84-09C, UL Standard 61010-1, CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 61010-1

PRODUCT_NAME: SP Wilmad-LabGlass ZrO2 Rotor, 3.2 mm Bruker MAS Probe
DESCRIPTION:
Manufactured from the highest purity Zirconia, our MAS Rotors provide the NMR spectroscopist with the ultimate alternative for analysis of solid samples; the need to solvate is eliminated. They are available for most present solid state NMR spectrometers. Wilmads MAS Rotors are carefully examined for material irregularities by optical methods before and after the precision machining process. Without over-spinning, each rotor is spin tested to only the highest specified spinning speed. Overspin testing, a common practice with some rotor brands, can actually damage the rotor prior to use. High precision (which becomes a necessity for proper spinning performance) is maintained in the manufacture of the end caps. Most caps are fitted with O-rings for better sealing; some have axial holes for venting.

Advantages of Zirconia Rotors:
• Most homogeneous ceramic material structure.
• Wilmads Zirconia Rotor Body has higher strength (1,000 MPa, greater than Si3N4).
• Highest spinning speed
• High precision superior finish (0.05 µ mirror gloss).

DESCRIPTION:
Fiberglass Blowers are ideal for fume hood exhaust systems in moderate to highly corrosive conditions. They are offered in a broad range of capacities from 250 to 3500 CFM at static pressures up to 4.0 in. Fiberglass Blowers are not recommended for use with perchloric acid use.
Features:
• Housings are made from molded fiberglass reinforced polyester for durability and long life
• Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres
• Dry powder epoxy-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Inlet and discharge diameters are sized to receive rigid PVC ducting material directly for easy installation. Blowers are available with 10, 12 and 16 in. inlet/outlet connections.
• Sheaves are adjustable to allow for air volume adjustment
• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener insures consistent performance because belt is held taut by weight of motor. Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail.
• Sound decibel levels for Fiberglass Blowers with 10 in. and 12 in. diameter inlets generally range between 64 and 88 dba, depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)
• Explosion-proof models have non-sparking polypropylene impellers and UL listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 4 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 4 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Floor-Mounted

DESCRIPTION:
Hamilton HV, HVP, HVX, HVM, and HVXM valves have a port depth of 5.6 mm (7/32) which is much shorter than the industry standard ports. This design minimizes the dead volume that is trapped in the valve port. To take advantage of this unique feature, a line of short adapters has been designed that will only work with Hamilton valves. These fittings have a 1/4-28 UNF thread connection on one side and either a male luer, female luer, or male luer lock on the other side.

Use tubing assemblies to connect tubing to valves (100psig or less). Use the female luer, male luer, luer lock and barbed fittings to connect syringes, equipment, or other devices to Hamilton valves. Fittings and adapters are constructed of Kel-F material (CTFE), except the male luer lock fittings and swivel union, which are made of Kel-F (CTFE) and metal. Some fittings are offered in two port diameters for fluid flow optimization.

PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_NAME: 6 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures and 1 GFCI Duplex, 100-115V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector XStream I-S Laboratory Hood takes containment, safety and energy savings to the extreme. With integrated sash position blower controls, this hood was designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

This general chemical, high performance fume hood was independently tested and challenged well beyond the SEFA-1 standards. With a face velocity of 40 fpm and sash fully open, the Protector XStream I-S was subjected to 50 fpm cross drafts, NIH protocol, and tracer gas measurements in the chest of the mannequin. In all scenarios, the Protector XStream I-S allowed 0.00 ppm average level of tracer gas outside the fume hood. Although your safety officer will determine the actual face velocity setting for your laboratory, the ability of this hood to contain under these adverse conditions sets a new standard of safety.

Safety is foremost, but energy savings is equally impressive. Although face velocity is a factor, its the volumetric rate (CFM) that determines the energy consumption. Operating a 6 Protector XStream I-S at 60 fpm face velocity, with the sash in its fully open position, requires only 690 CFM. Regardless of your desired operating face velocity, the Protector XStream I-S yields the lowest required CFM of any hood.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 72 x 37.7 x 59 in.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 610.0 lbs

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 6 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 6 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Floor-Mounted

The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed

• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air and vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided

PRODUCT_NAME: Erlab® Captair 633 Smart Ductless Filtering Fume Hood
DESCRIPTION:
Erlab® Captair 633 (633DFH) ductless filtering fume hood and powder weighing stations are designed with advanced carbon filtration to provide you with a safe working environment. Chemical exposure is eliminated by the configurable filtering system above the enclosure. Installation is simple and no ductwork is necessary allowing for relocation. The units will arrive completely knocked down and will require assembly. With the push of one button, it will set you free of limitations in order to focus on what is most important: your work.

Each unit comes with Smart Technology™ – an exclusive set of tools that consists of Smart-Light Communication™, chemical sensors (optional), real-time status, and the eGuard app. Smart Technology gives you an easily identifiable method of communication regarding containment, performance and filter efficiency via a soft, LED band of light called Smart-Light. Smart-Light is a light signature across the front panel which casts a stable LED glow ensuring proper operation. If normal operation is disrupted, the reassuring LED light pulses and sounds, drawing the attention of the operator. eGuard App allows you to monitor and control you're the system remotely using your PC or mobile app.

Options such as a hinged sloped sash design, or reverse sash are available. Order work surface and base separately. Filters are ordered separately, based on your handlings and validation report and needed for product functionality. PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 4 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures, 208-230V, 50/60Hz
PRODUCT_NAME: 4 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures, 208-230V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector XStream I-S Laboratory Hood takes containment, safety and energy savings to the extreme. With integrated sash position blower controls, this hood was designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

This general chemical, high performance fume hood was independently tested and challenged well beyond the SEFA-1 standards. With a face velocity of 40 fpm and sash fully open, the Protector XStream I-S was subjected to 50 fpm cross drafts, NIH protocol, and tracer gas measurements in the chest of the mannequin. In all scenarios, the Protector XStream I-S allowed 0.00 ppm average level of tracer gas outside the fume hood. Although your safety officer will determine the actual face velocity setting for your laboratory, the ability of this hood to contain under these adverse conditions sets a new standard of safety.

Safety is foremost, but energy savings is equally impressive. Although face velocity is a factor, its the volumetric rate (CFM) that determines the energy consumption. Operating a 6 Protector XStream I-S at 60 fpm face velocity, with the sash in its fully open position, requires only 690 CFM. Regardless of your desired operating face velocity, the Protector XStream I-S yields the lowest required CFM of any hood.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 48 x 37.7 x 59 in.
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Lighting: LED
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 450.0 lbs

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Two Service Fixtures and One GFCI Duplex, Extra Deep 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Two Service Fixtures and One GFCI Duplex, Extra Deep 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.
• One pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle (two on 8 ft. models only)

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_NAME: 3 ft Airo Hood, Two Service Fixtures, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Airo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 3 ft. & 4 ft. widths and 31.7 in. & 37.7 in. depths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.
Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.
Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing & electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• eGuard2 software communication
• Factory-installed command module, fan button & light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height & <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent & acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, & temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight & powder-coated aluminum sash handle & tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height on 4 ft models and 13 in. sash opening height on 3 ft models. Sash opens to 26 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles & four service fixtures
• 28.5 in. high sightline from the work surface & header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas & cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood
• Work Surface
• Base Cabinet or Stand

Options Acessories (Not Included)
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Enclosure Height: 54.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Power Cord & Plug: 11.75 ft power cord with plug
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Benchtop

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Replacement Handheld vacuum controller with single channel adapters (A, B, C), for Aspire Laboratory Aspirator
PRODUCT_NAME: Replacement Handheld vacuum controller with single channel adapters (A, B, C), for Aspire Laboratory Aspirator
DESCRIPTION:
The ASPIRE is an ideal choice for a wide range of laboratory aspirating applications, including removal of media from tissue culture vessels or plates, and supernatants. An ergonomic, hand held controller is included, and holds standard 200 to 300ul disposable pipette tips. The hand held controller, and adapters are made of POM (Polyoxymethylene), and fully autoclavable. The Polycarbonate collection bottle incorporates a reliable Overflow Protection Valve that closes off the tube to the vacuum in the event of a full bottle. In addition, the replaceable in-line filter protects the vacuum pump from contaminants and any moisture that comes through the bottle. Graduations on the collection bottle indicate the amount of fluid collected and when its ready to be emptied. The Handheld Vacuum Controller has an ergonomic design thats comfortable in the hand during prolonged use. Pressing the button applies the vacuum. The pipette accepts Pasteur pipettes, serological pipettes, and also comes with 2 accessory pipette cones. One cone is designed to accommodate 200/300ul pipette tips, the other has a thin, stainless steel capillary for fine control aspirating.

Specifications:
• Max. Aspiration: 14 mL / sec.
• Max. Flow: 15L / min.
• Vacuum Range: -30 to -750mbar
• Noise Level: 59.6 db
• Vacuum Pump: oil free piston
• Dimensions: 9.5 x 7.9 x 13.5 in.
• Weight: 4.8 lbs
• Electrical: 115V, 60 Hz
• Warranty: 2 years

The Aspire comes complete with:
• Base with internal vacuum pump
• 2 Liter, polycarbonate collection bottle (Replacement Cat. No. 975-10589)
• Antibacterial / hydrophobic filter (Replacement Cat. No. 885-10025)
• Silicone tubing (Replacement Cat. No. 975-10592)
• Handheld vacuum controller (Replacement Cat. No. 675-10379)
• Adapter for 200ul pipette tips (Replacement included with Cat. No. 675-10379)
• Adapter, fine tip stainless steel, 40 mm (Replacement included with Cat. No. 675-10379)

Available optionally:
• Extra long, (80mm) fine tip stainless steel (Cat. No. 675-10370)
• 8-channel adapter, fine tip stainless steel (Cat. No. 675-10376)
• 8-channel adapter for 200ul pipette tips (Cat. No. 675-10373)

DESCRIPTION:
Fiberglass Blowers are ideal for fume hood exhaust systems in moderate to highly corrosive conditions. They are offered in a broad range of capacities from 250 to 3500 CFM at static pressures up to 4.0 in. Fiberglass Blowers are not recommended for use with perchloric acid use.
Features:
• Housings are made from molded fiberglass reinforced polyester for durability and long life
• Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres
• Dry powder epoxy-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Inlet and discharge diameters are sized to receive rigid PVC ducting material directly for easy installation. Blowers are available with 10, 12 and 16 in. inlet/outlet connections.
• Sheaves are adjustable to allow for air volume adjustment
• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener insures consistent performance because belt is held taut by weight of motor. Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail.
• Sound decibel levels for Fiberglass Blowers with 10 in. and 12 in. diameter inlets generally range between 64 and 88 dba, depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)
• Explosion-proof models have non-sparking polypropylene impellers and UL listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety

DESCRIPTION:
Fiberglass Blowers are ideal for fume hood exhaust systems in moderate to highly corrosive conditions. They are offered in a broad range of capacities from 250 to 3500 CFM at static pressures up to 4.0 in. Fiberglass Blowers are not recommended for use with perchloric acid use.
Features:
• Housings are made from molded fiberglass reinforced polyester for durability and long life
• Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres
• Dry powder epoxy-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Inlet and discharge diameters are sized to receive rigid PVC ducting material directly for easy installation. Blowers are available with 10, 12 and 16 in. inlet/outlet connections.
• Sheaves are adjustable to allow for air volume adjustment
• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener insures consistent performance because belt is held taut by weight of motor. Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail.
• Sound decibel levels for Fiberglass Blowers with 10 in. and 12 in. diameter inlets generally range between 64 and 88 dba, depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)
• Explosion-proof models have non-sparking polypropylene impellers and UL listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety

DESCRIPTION:
Oil mist filters (FO) protect air, both inside and outside the laboratory, from contaminated oil mist. Exhaust gases from oil-sealed rotary vane pumps always carry a certain quantity of oil mist. This is extremely unpleasant, and even harmful, for those working nearby. VACUUBRAND oil mist filters separate nearly 100% of oil mist at the ultimate vacuum of the pump. Optimal control by the included catchpot made of transparent plastic (PMP) with good chemical resistance.

• Very high degree of separation
• Easy draining of oil
• Direct mounting on the oil reservoir outlet
• Integrated pressure relief valve for burst protection in case of blocked filter

PRODUCT_NAME: SP Wilmad-LabGlass 7 mm Bruker MAS Rotor Set, 2 Rotors, 2 Kel-F and 1 Torlon Cap(s)
DESCRIPTION:
Manufactured from the highest purity Zirconia, our MAS Rotors provide the NMR spectroscopist with the ultimate alternative for analysis of solid samples; the need to solvate is eliminated. They are available for most present solid state NMR spectrometers. Wilmads MAS Rotors are carefully examined for material irregularities by optical methods before and after the precision machining process. Without over-spinning, each rotor is spin tested to only the highest specified spinning speed. Overspin testing, a common practice with some rotor brands, can actually damage the rotor prior to use. High precision (which becomes a necessity for proper spinning performance) is maintained in the manufacture of the end caps. Most caps are fitted with O-rings for better sealing; some have axial holes for venting. Some of our caps have a uniquely designed detachable O-ring. Use it when a gas-tight environment is required for the sample.

Advantages of Zirconia Rotors
• Most homogeneous ceramic material structure.
• Wilmads Zirconia Rotor Body has higher strength (1,000 MPa, greater than Si3N4).
• Highest spinning speed
• High precision superior finish (0.05 µ mirror gloss).
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Triple your usable working area with two supplied accessory refractory shelves using Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Largest Tabletop Muffle Furnace. Designed for safe operation, these furnaces are available in three temperature control models. Requires: Electrical connection requires fixed wiring (no power cord).

• Advanced LED digital-set/digital-display temperature controller is microprocessor-controlled
• LED display simultaneously shows both setpoint and actual furnace temperatures in °C or °F
• User-selectable overtemperature protection
• Open thermocouple protection
• Adjustable power output from 1 to 100%

Safety and Design Features:
• Heating elements are on chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of chamber incorporates a 0.95cm (0.38in.) diameter port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Critical electronic components and heating elements are protected by a 35A circuit breaker
• Door safety switch stops power to the heating elements when door opens

• Furnaces that use B1, C1 or D1 control also use a mechanical Overtemperature Protection relay
• B1: Digital single setpoint control with a single ramp to setpoint and dwell; single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• C1: Digital programmable control with one stored program of 8 segments
• D1: Digital programmable control with 4 stored programs, 16 segments per program, and RS-232 communications interface

• Operating temperature range: 100°to 1093°C

• Overall dimensions (W x H x D): 21.5 x 29.5 x 25.5 in. (54.6 x 74.9 x 64.7 cm)
• Chamber volume: 1.6 cubic feet (46.6 L)
• Chamber uniformity at 1000°C: +/-3.45°C

• Temperature readout: °C and °F

DESCRIPTION: The FLIR T865 thermal imaging camera is a non-contact inspection tool with a 180° rotating optical block that allows users to safely and comfortably assess the condition of critical electrical and mechanical equipment in utility and manufacturing applications. With advanced features including unmatched temperature measurements down to -40°C, accuracy as good as ±1°C / ±1%, 1-Touch Level/Span contrast enhancement, and laser-assisted autofocus, you'll get highly accurate temperature measurements every time. • Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres

• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life

• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)

DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood
• Work Surface
• Base Cabinet or Stand

Options Available Include
• HEPA filter
• Sash Opening Wing Reduction Kits
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Compliance
• SEFA 9, DHIII, SEFA 8, Cabinet Surface Finish Tests, Modified ASHRAE 110, ANSI Z9.5-2011, AFNOR NF-X 15-211, ASTM E84-09C, UL Standard 61010-1, CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 61010-1

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Benchtop

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, 100-115V, 50/60Hz
PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, 100-115V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector XStream I-S Laboratory Hood takes containment, safety and energy savings to the extreme. With integrated sash position blower controls, this hood was designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

This general chemical, high performance fume hood was independently tested and challenged well beyond the SEFA-1 standards. With a face velocity of 40 fpm and sash fully open, the Protector XStream I-S was subjected to 50 fpm cross drafts, NIH protocol, and tracer gas measurements in the chest of the mannequin. In all scenarios, the Protector XStream I-S allowed 0.00 ppm average level of tracer gas outside the fume hood. Although your safety officer will determine the actual face velocity setting for your laboratory, the ability of this hood to contain under these adverse conditions sets a new standard of safety.

Safety is foremost, but energy savings is equally impressive. Although face velocity is a factor, its the volumetric rate (CFM) that determines the energy consumption. Operating a 6 Protector XStream I-S at 60 fpm face velocity, with the sash in its fully open position, requires only 690 CFM. Regardless of your desired operating face velocity, the Protector XStream I-S yields the lowest required CFM of any hood.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 96 x 37.7 x 59 in.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Lighting: LED
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 780.0 lbs
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air and vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided
side)

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood
• Work Surface
• Base Cabinet or Stand

Options Available Include
• HEPA filter
• Sash Opening Wing Reduction Kits
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Compliance
• SEFA 9, DHIII, SEFA 8, Cabinet Surface Finish Tests, Modified ASHRAE 110, ANSI Z9.5-2011, AFNOR NF-X 15-211, ASTM E84-09C, UL Standard 61010-1, CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 61010-1

• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley

• Style: Benchtop

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S Premier Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures and 1 GFCI Duplex, 100-115V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Premier I-S Laboratory Hoods incorporate a sleek interior with a molded one-piece fiberglass liner, the signature feature of Labconcos leading line of fume hoods since 1961. The one-piece liner of specially-formulated, fiberglass-reinforced polyester offers corrosion and fire resistance and easy clean up. Without seams, the interior has fewer points of deterioration for longer life.

Designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers, Protector Premier I-S Hoods feature integrated sash position blower controls. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

These hoods are suitable for providing personal protection needed for general chemistry applications involving fumes and vapors. They meet the SEFA-1 standard of a low velocity, high performance hood and may be safely operated as low as 60 fpm.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 96 x 31.7 x 59 in.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 660.0 lbs
• Lighting: LED

DESCRIPTION:
Vacuum filtration is one of the most common applications used for sample preparation in chemistry, microbiology, waste water control and other analytical processes. The new ME 1 diaphragm pump offers a compact, high performance and easy-to-use solution which is perfect for single port filtrations. This new development, based on the highly successful technology of the oil-free diaphragm pump MD 1C, provides a well-proven and extraordinarily long diaphragm life time. This functional, space saving and innovative design with visible top mounted power switch ensures convenient and quick operation for day to day lab work. The PTFE diaphragm and valves are rugged and provide high chemical resistance. An optional manual regulator valve with dial gauge enables variable fine adjustment of the pumping speed and ultimate vacuum.

• Convenient, quick and simple to use due to the new top mounted power switch
• Whisper quiet and very low vibration
• Requires minimal benchtop space
• Maintenance-free drive system and proven long diaphragm life
• Wetted materials: PTFE, aluminum
• Supplied complete with integrated motor, on/off switch, cable with plug, operating manual, and one-year manufacturers warranty

Specifications:
• Max. pumping speed at 50/60 Hz: 0.4 cfm (14 L/min.)
• Ultimate vacuum (abs.): 100 mbar (75 Torr)
• Number of heads / stages: 1 / 1
• Ambient operating temperature range: 10 to 40 DEG C
• Inlet connection: Hose nozzle DN 8-10 mm
• Outlet connection: Hose nozzle DN 8-10 mm
• Rated motor power: 0.04 kW
• Rated motor speed at 50/60 Hz: 1500/1800 min-1
• Degree of protection: IP 40
• Dimensions (L x W x H): 247 x 121 x 145 mm
• Weight: 5.0 kg
• Noise level at 50 Hz, typical: 45 dBA
• NRTL certification Canada and the USA

ME1C Accessories
• Rubber vacuum tubing DN 8 mm (Catalog No. 670-10400)
• Chemistry vacuum regulator valve unit (Catalog No. 670-10421)
• Silencer DN 8 - 10 mm (Catalog No. 670-10589)

DESCRIPTION:
An operating concept that is focused on the essentials: clear and with access to the basic parameters rotation speed and heating bath temperature at any time.

• Clear digital display showing actual and set values
• Two separate knobs with dynamic control for setting the rotation speed and heating bath temperature: fast turning for large jumps, slow turning for precise setting of the set values
• Accidental changing of the values can be prevented by the lock function
• Intuitive LED ring light system makes activated functions clearly visible even from a distance
• Easy adjustment of the immersion depth up to 155 mm and the inclination angle from 20 DEG to 80 DEG
• Standby function and residual heat warning at heating bath temperatures above 50 DEG C
• The standby button stops all functions and, when using a motor lift model, lifts the evaporating flask from the heating bath

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 8 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Floor-Mounted

• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures

• Power cord with plug
