PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, B1 Digital Single Setpoint with Ramp and Dwell, CSA
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

DESCRIPTION:
Fiberglass Blowers are ideal for fume hood exhaust systems in moderate to highly corrosive conditions. They are offered in a broad range of capacities from 250 to 3500 CFM at static pressures up to 4.0 in. Fiberglass Blowers are not recommended for use with perchloric acid use.
Features:
• Housings are made from molded fiberglass reinforced polyester for durability and long life
• Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres
• Dry powder epoxy-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Inlet and discharge diameters are sized to receive rigid PVC ducting material directly for easy installation. Blowers are available with 10, 12 and 16 in. inlet/outlet connections.
• Sheaves are adjustable to allow for air volume adjustment
• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener insures consistent performance because belt is held taut by weight of motor. Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail.
• Sound decibel levels for Fiberglass Blowers with 10 in. and 12 in. diameter inlets generally range between 64 and 88 dba, depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)
• Explosion-proof models have non-sparking polypropylene impellers and UL listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Double Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box with Auto Pressure Control, 4 Ports, N. America, 110-115V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Double Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box with Auto Pressure Control, 4 Ports, N. America, 110-115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method

• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control

• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.

• Manufactured from 33 expansion, low extractable borosilicate glass conforming to USP Type I and ASTM E438, Type I, Class A requirements

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Protector Echo Filtered Benchtop Hood, 2 Service Fixtures, Side Windows, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air and vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided
side)
• Right and left side-mounted tempered safety glass windows

• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 4 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 4 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Extra Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_NAME: 4 XPert Balance Enclosure Easy-Order, includes 4 XPert Enclosure with Guardian 1000 Digital Airflow Monitor 3930402, FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter 3970000, 4 Black Work Surface 3908402, 115V, 60 Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The XPert Easy-Order includes the XPert Balance Enclosure, Black Solid Epoxy Dished Work Surface and FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter (Spectrum Cat. No. 496-50086).

XPert Balance Enclosures provide user protection by keeping powders, particulates and fume contained during weighing procedures. Containment enhancing features include: patented, aerodynamic Clean-Sweep air foil; side-entry air foils; upper dilution air supply; upper containment sash foil; patented zone-perforated rear baffle; and static-dissipating construction.

The FilterMate contains an 99.99% efficient, oversized HEPA filter to remove hazardous powders, particulates or vapors from the exhaust air stream, returning filtered air to the environment. A true bag-in/bag-out filter disposal system provides safe and easily accessible replacement of the HEPA filter.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Fiberglass Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: High Viscosity Industrial Lever Drum Pump, for Oils, Lubricants
PRODUCT_NAME: High Viscosity Industrial Lever Drum Pump, for Oils, Lubricants
DESCRIPTION:
High Viscosity Drum Pump is ideal for use with high-viscosity liquids. Pumps 18-32 ounce per stroke and can be used with paraffin, motor oil, cutting oil, and many viscous lubricants. Features a 36 telescoping tube which will fit into the bottom of a 55 gallon drum, a 2 bung adapter, ad two spouts: both a high-angle discharge spout with screen, and a normal curved discharge spout. This industrial strength pump has been shown to transfer over 10,000 gallons before piston requires replacement.

  • Strainer: 2 Spouts Screened
  • Telescoping Suction Tube
  • Bung Adapter: 2 Inch
  • Piston: Polyethylene
  • Pump Body: Reinforced Die Cast
  • Seals: Neoprene
  • Discharge Ports: interchangeable High Angle spout and Normal Curved spout

PRODUCT_NAME: Lindberg/Blue M Moldatherm Box Furnace, with RS-485 Digital Communications Port, 42.5 L, 1100 degree C, 240V (p/n 196-19940 is required)
DESCRIPTION:
Minimize outer surface temperatures while maintaining uniform heat distribution within the chamber. Thermo Scientific™ Lindberg/Blue M™ Moldatherm™ Box Furnaces include unique insulation and heating element composites, and are available in several popular chamber sizes to meet the most demanding laboratory applications. Advanced engineering and specialized construction techniques include variable density insulation, double shell cabinets, long-life heating elements and horizontal side swing doors.

Microprocessor-Based Control
• Selectable self-tuning feature sets best control parameters for the thermal process
• PID control (proportional, integral, derivative) prevents overshoot
• Main power ON/OFF switch on control panel
• Controlled heat-up rate eliminates thermal shock to materials
• Quick heat-up and cool-down rates
• Adjustable high-limit overtemperature protection
• Simultaneous LED display of actual temperature vs. setpoint
• Can be configured to display temperature in either °C or °F

Construction
• Unique double wall minimizes exterior surface temperatures for operator safety and energy efficiency
• Side-hinge door for convenient operation and full chamber access
• Long-life Type K thermocouple
• Air vent (1 in. dia., top) and air inlet (0.375 in. dia., rear) for inert atmosphere exchange; will experience some leakage at door
• Removable and replaceable Moldatherm hearth plate supports load and prevents damage due to spillage
• Energy-efficient Moldatherm insulation with embedded heating elements
•Safety door switch to interrupt power to heating element when door is opened; protects heating element and minimizes exposure to end-user

Digital, Single-Setpoint Controller
• Single segment, single setpoint, one ramp to setpoint

Digital Single-Program, Multiple-Segment Programmable Controller
• Single program with multiple segments for ramp (up and down) and dwell (timed hold) temperature control

Ordering Information:
• Optional RS485 Digital Communications Port allows controller to be connected to a PC for remote monitoring and control of the furnace. Up to 30 units can be connected to one PC.

Includes
• 10 ft. power cord except 1.5 cu. ft. models which require customer-supplied power cord or hardwiring.

PRODUCT_NAME: 6 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Deep, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_NAME: Air Inlet Evaporation Control Valve, 1/4-28 PTFE with 6 month Reminder Timer
DESCRIPTION:
Air Inlet Evaporation Control Valve, 1/4-28 PTFE with 6 month Reminder Timer.

Air Inlet filter with integrated PTFE membrane allows air into the bottle but captures dust and other contaminants to keep your solvent delivery system clean.

  • 1-way valve blocks solvent fumes from escaping
  • Fits 1/4-28 UNF holes on standard port caps
  • Time strip turns red after 6 months to indicate you should order a replacement filter

Includes an activate time strip so the end user can indicate the starting date and ensure a consistent replacement schedule. Simply press the "on" button when you install the filter to start the 6 month countdown.

*Please note that the time strip is a visual reminder based on time rather than saturation, based on a typical usage of 1mL/min, 5 days per week, 8 hours per day under typical lab conditions of 20°C. If your own usage is higher or lower than average, please devise your own replacement schedule accordingly.

Air Inlet Control Valve fits the following port caps (and others with a 1/4-28 UNF hole):

PRODUCT_NAME: Ring illuminator with 144 LEDs with Adjustable Light Intensity
DESCRIPTION:
The LED Ring Illuminator produces intense white light for long microscopy observation sessions. The 144 LED intensity direction adjustable ring light has a mounting size up to 2-1/2 in. (64 mm) in diameter. The light ring is consisted of 4 individual portions (4 lighting zones) that can be turned on/off separately.

You may use the feature to change lighting directions and obtain the best illumination for your application. The ring light has 2-1/2 in. (64 mm) inside and 4 in. (100 mm) outside diameters. It works with a 110-220VAC power supply and comes with a 1-7/8 in. (48 mm in diameter) ring adapter.

Electrogalvanized steel wall for maximum durability Lip at the front edge of work surface ensures that any spillage is contained in the work zone. Sentinel™ microprocessor control system with audible and visual alarms for unsafe conditions. Front service panel opens up easily for maintenance functions Optional VOC sensor to monitor chemical concentration within the cabinet work zone. All cabinet service and filter replacement can be carried out from the front, allowing the cabinet to be placed against wall in the laboratory to save space. Over 8 different Nanocarb™ filter types to choose from: Volatile organic compounds, acid, mercury, sulfur, halogen, aldehyde, ammonia or ethers/chloroform.

PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, Two Service Fixtures and One GFCI Duplex, Deep 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.
• One pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle (two on 8 ft. models only)

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Stainless Steel Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box, 2 Ports, N. America, 208-230V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes provide a leak-tight environment to perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment. Fiberglass-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels a low as 0.4 ppm & moisture levels as low as 2 ppm. Stainless steel-lined models are performance tested to maintain oxygen levels as low as 0.2 ppm & moisture levels as low as 1 ppm.
All Protector Controlled Atmosphere Glove Boxes are compatible with the new AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier accessory, which has the capacity to remove up to five liters of oxygen (13.500 ppm) & 660 grams of moisture (18 million ppm) at standard temperature and pressure (STP).
Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium at 5 inches of water gauge
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) & <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• Four manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler at +/-6 inches of water gauge
• Two rear-mounted inlet & oulet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train
• Large viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick, laminated safety glass
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches.
• Interior right-hand side wall-mounted electrical duplex receptacle with 10 amp maximum (100/115V) or 10 amp maximum (230V) circuit load.
• Interior side wall-mounted pass through plug for on-site installation of an optional accessory
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light, blower & electrical duplex.
• Two 8 in. ID, epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• Two fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Options-All Models
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• International electrical configuration

Options-Basic Models
• Main chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from -5 to +5 inches of water gauge
• Transfer chamber pressure analog gauge with readings from 0 to 29.5 inches of mercury

Options-Fiberglass-Lined Models
• Clear acrylic inner and outer transfer chamber doors

Options-Stainless Steel-Lined Models
• Type 304 stainless steel inner and outer transfer chamber doors and front panel

Options-Auto Pressure Control Models
• Automatic Pressure Controller controls main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Mutable, audible alarm that sounds when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• LCD display of main chamber and transfer chamber pressure in inches of water, inches of mercury and mBar
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

Required Accessories
• Adjustable height base stands
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

Optional Accessories
• AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, Two Service Fixtures, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air & vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not included.
• One pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle (two on 8 ft. models only)

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 2
• Style: Floor-Mounted

PRODUCT_NAME: 4 ft. Protector I-S Premier Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures and 1 GFCI Duplex, 100-115V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Premier I-S Laboratory Hoods incorporate a sleek interior with a molded one-piece fiberglass liner, the signature feature of Labconcos leading line of fume hoods since 1961. The one-piece liner of specially-formulated, fiberglass-reinforced polyester offers corrosion and fire resistance and easy clean up. Without seams, the interior has fewer points of deterioration for longer life.

Designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers, Protector Premier I-S Hoods feature integrated sash position blower controls. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

These hoods are suitable for providing personal protection needed for general chemistry applications involving fumes and vapors. They meet the SEFA-1 standard of a low velocity, high performance hood and may be safely operated as low as 60 fpm.

Specifications
• Nominal Width: 4 ft.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 48.0 x 31.7 x 59.0 in.
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Lighting: LED
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 335.0 lbs

PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Largest Tabletop Muffle Furnace, 240V, C1 Digital Programmable w/1 Program, 8 Segments, CSA
DESCRIPTION:
Triple your usable working area with two supplied accessory refractory shelves using Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Largest Tabletop Muffle Furnace. Designed for safe operation, these furnaces are available in three temperature control models. They are ideal for annealing glass, determinations of volatiles, catalyst research and ashing organic and inorganic samples. Includes: Two refractory shelves. Requires: Electrical connection requires fixed wiring (no power cord).

Key Features:
• Advanced LED digital-set/digital-display temperature controller is microprocessor-controlled
• LED display simultaneously shows both setpoint and actual furnace temperatures in °C or °F
• User-selectable overtemperature protection
• Open thermocouple protection
• Adjustable power output from 1 to 100%

Safety and Design Features:
• Heating elements are on chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of chamber incorporates a 0.95cm (0.38in.) diameter port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Critical electronic components and heating elements are protected by a 35A circuit breaker
• Door safety switch stops power to the heating elements when door opens

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Furnaces that use B1, C1 or D1 control also use a mechanical Overtemperature Protection relay
• B1: Digital single setpoint control with a single ramp to setpoint and dwell; single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• C1: Digital programmable control with one stored program of 8 segments
• D1: Digital programmable control with 4 stored programs, 16 segments per program, and RS-232 communications interface

Specifications for all furnaces:
• Operating temperature range: 100°to 1093°C
• Chamber dimensions (W x H x D): 14 x 14 x 14 in. (36 x 36 x 36 cm)
• Overall dimensions (W x H x D): 21.5 x 29.5 x 25.5 in. (54.6 x 74.9 x 64.7 cm)
• Chamber volume: 1.6 cubic feet (46.6 L)
• Chamber uniformity at 1000°C: +/-3.45°C
• Chamber stability at 1000°C: +/-1.2°C
• Temperature readout: °C and °F
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Protector Double Stainless Steel Combination Glove Box, 4 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
PRODUCT_NAME: Protector Double Stainless Steel Combination Glove Box, 4 Ports, N. America, 100-115V
DESCRIPTION:
These stainless steel or fiberglass-lined glove boxes have the capability to function as either a filtered box or a controlled atmosphere box. Protector Combination Glove Boxes provide inlet and outlet HEPA or ULPA filtration & a leak-tight physical barrier to protect the operator from exposure to potentially hazardous materials & perform work with contamination-sensitive materials under vacuum or in an inert environment.

Features
• Factory leak-tested with a mass spectrometer while pressurized with helium
• LCD display provides real time monitoring of volume dilution rates, air changes/minute, main chamber pressure, & transfer chamber in inches of mercury and mBar
• Laminated safety glass viewing area, 36 in. wide x 27.6 in. high x .38 in. thick
• Space-saving inner & outer transfer chamber doors that pivot upward, counterbalanced & equipped with quick-latches
• Interior side wall-mounted electrical receptacle with 10 amp maximum. Double gloves boxes have an additional centrally-mounted interior duplex receptacle
• 2 internal valves to convert glove box from a flow-through filtered box to an inert atmosphere glove box
• Pair of neoprene gloves
• Switches for light & electrical duplex.
• 2 epoxy-coated aluminum double-grooved glove ports mounted with neoprene gaskets
• 2 fluorescent lights
• Dry-powder epoxy-coated, 18 & 20 gauge steel exterior panels

Filtered Glove Box
• Particulate containment <20 nanograms per cubic
• Fast clean up time. 0.05 ppm average tracer gas levels or less detected during perimeter scan testing after 5 minute dilution
• Airborne particulate cleanliness (measured under positive and negative pressures per ISO 14544-1 test method) exceeds ISO Class 5 conditions & achieves ISO Class 4 conditions
• Inlet and outlet particulate (HEPA or ULPA) filters to prevent contaminants from entering or leaving glove box chamber
• Test port for challenging HEPA or ULPA filter integrity
• True Bag-In/Bag-Out Filter Disposal System for safe filter removal & replacement
• Built-in blower with speed control capable of airflow from 15 CFM to 85 CFM

Controlled Atmosphere Glove Box
• Exceed Class I atmosphere containment conditions for oxygen permeation <1.67 ppm/min per ISO 10648-2 test method
• Oxygen permeation <0.3 ppm/min (fiberglass-lined models) and <0.15 ppm/min (stainless steel-lined models) per ISO 10648-2
• 4 manual valves for evacuating, filling & added control, with compression fittings
• Automatic control of the main chamber pressure, main chamber evacuation & filling cycles, & transfer chamber evacuation & filling cycles
• Regulation of vacuum/pressure between -5 and +5 inches of water gauge in the main chamber & between 0 and -29.5 inches of mercury in the transfer chamber
• Mutable, audible alarm for when pressure/vacuum level is outside set limits
• Three-position foot pedal
• Input/output port for optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier
• Factory-installed, rear-mounted, low profile stainless steel pressure relief bubbler
• Two rear-mounted inlet and outlet compression fittings for easy connection to optional AtmosPure Re-Gen Gas Purifier or other accessory drying train

Options
• Double wide models with 4 glove ports for 2 operators
• Chemical resistant, one-piece molded fiberglass liner or type 304 stainless steel liner
• Inlet and outlet 99.99% efficient HEPA or 99.999% efficient ULPA filters

Required Accessories
• Base Stand
• Vacuum source
• Inert gas for filling

DESCRIPTION:
Esco® Ascent™ Max – B Series Ductless Fume Hood - Standard (ADC-5B2)  utilizes a carbon filtration system to remove toxic chemical fumes and recycle clean air back to the laboratory. This airflow principle provides operator and environment protection. Ductless fume hoods are becoming a viable alternative to ducted fume hoods as no extraction systems are required, and its plug-and-play feature prevents any downtime in the laboratory. Esco ductless fume hoods also offer energy savings, convenience, and mobility. Esco Ascent™ Max-B Series (ADC-B) is the standard ductless fume hood model. This unit is equipped with a main carbon filter and is used for general applications such as dilution, mixing, buffer preparation, etc. FEATURES Robust Hood Construction Key components including Fluorescent Lamps, Motor Capacitor, Electrical parts, and Switch Control are mounted outside the airstream and away from contaminated areas to permit easy service.

Centrifugal Fan Permanently lubricated fans are energy-efficient with external rotor motor design that reduces operating costs Extremely low noise and low vibration level Filtration System Main Filter: Nanocarb™ Activated carbon, available in 8 types Efficient perimeter clamping ensures no leakage as well as allows easy filter change procedure Optional VOC Sensor Detects presence of volatile organic compounds in the exhaust and alarms to indicate filter saturation.

Worktop Options Standard SS steel worktop can be upgraded to phenolic resin or epoxy for better chemical resistance.

Isocide™ Antimicrobial Powder Coating Eliminates 99.9% of surface bacteria within 24 hours of exposure.

PRODUCT_NAME: 3 XPert Balance Enclosure Easy-Order, includes 3 XPert Enclosure with Guardian 1000 Digital Airflow Monitor 3930302, FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter 3970000, 3 Black Work Surface 3908401, 115V, 60 Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The XPert Easy-Order includes the XPert Balance Enclosure, Black Solid Epoxy Dished Work Surface and FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter (Spectrum Cat. No. 496-50086).

XPert Balance Enclosures provide user protection by keeping powders, particulates and fume contained during weighing procedures. Containment enhancing features include: patented, aerodynamic Clean-Sweep air foil; side-entry air foils; upper dilution air supply; upper containment sash foil; patented zone-perforated rear baffle; and static-dissipating construction.

FilterMate Portable Exhauster provides an alternative when ducting to the outside is not feasible. The FilterMate contains an 99.99% efficient, oversized HEPA filter to remove hazardous powders, particulates or vapors from the exhaust air stream, returning filtered air to the environment. A true bag-in/bag-out filter disposal system provides safe and easily accessible replacement of the HEPA filter.

• Electrical: 115 volts, 60 Hz, Domestic
• Airflow Monitor: Guardian Jr.
• Blower Requirements: None. FilterMate Portable Exhauster 3970000 is included.
• Conformance: ANSI Z9.5, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 1
• Electrical Standard: Domestic
• Lighting: None. Light Kit Accessory available.
• Sash Opening Height: 8.0 in. (20.3 cm)

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Protector Echo Floor-Mounted Filtered Fume Hood, No Service Fixtures, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Echo Filtered Floor-Mounted Fume Hoods provide the interior height needed for bulky apparatus with no ducting required. These hoods feature fully-closing, vertical-rising sashes. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position & temperature may be observed & managed.

The Echo uses Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters, the most comprehensive, safety-driven carbon filter available. This single molecular filter type can easily adsorb most chemicals & mixtures, taking the guesswork out of filter selection. Erlab-proven Neutrodine Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Floor-Mounted models include a fiberglass panelized liner & three exterior depths: 37.7 in., 43.7 in., and 55.7 in. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sashes with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings.
• Removable front & side panels, and front & interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Rear baffle
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights for up to 63 foot candles rated for 50,000 hours
• Factory-prepared for up to two electrical duplex receptacles and six service fixtures
• Roughing prefilters
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity with only an upper sash opening height of 16 in.
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40°C (104°F), fan failure & high sash position opening. At 60°C (140°F), all fans stop
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

Available Options
• HEPA filter
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Conformance: AFNOR NF-X, ANSI Z9.5, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 9, UL 61010
• Enclosure Height: 102.2 in.
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Floor-Mounted

DESCRIPTION:
An accessory for the Demonstration Hood, XPert Balance Enclosure, Protector XVS Ventilation Station or Protector Work Station, the FilterMate uses a HEPA filter, carbon-based filter or a combination of both filters to remove hazardous powders, particulates or vapors from the exhaust air stream, returning filtered air to the environment. No ducting to the outside is required.

Includes HEPA Filter, 99.99% efficient on particulates 0.3 micron in size, with true bag-in/bag-out filter disposal system for safely removing and replacing the filter without detaching the hose. The HEPA filter may be easily accessed by removing the exhaust cover for field leak testing by a certified technician.

Specifications:
• Weight: 50.0 lbs. (22.7 kg)
• Dimensions: 14 w x 23 d x 22.7 h in. (36 x 58 x 58 cm)
• Electrical: 115 volts, 60 Hz, 10A

Required Accessories:
• Carbon Filter (Models for use with carbon filter only). Models for use with a carbon filter require an Organic Vapor Cell, Formaldehyde Impregnated Cell, or Ammonia Impregnated Cell. Combination models can support the use of two carbon filters by removing the HEPA filter.

DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air and vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided
side)
• One pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle on lower right side, (on 8 ft. models only, an additional pre-wired GFCI electrical duplex receptacle on lower left side)

• Right and left side-mounted tempered safety glass windows

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

PRODUCT_NAME: 2 XPert Balance Enclosure Easy-Order, includes 2 XPert Enclosure with Guardian 1000 Digital Airflow Monitor 3930202, FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter 3970000, 2 Black Work Surface 3908400, 115V, 60 Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The XPert Easy-Order includes the XPert Balance Enclosure, Black Solid Epoxy Dished Work Surface and FilterMate Portable Exhauster with HEPA Filter (Spectrum Cat. No. 496-50086).

XPert Balance Enclosures provide user protection by keeping powders, particulates and fume contained during weighing procedures. Containment enhancing features include: patented, aerodynamic Clean-Sweep air foil; side-entry air foils; upper dilution air supply; upper containment sash foil; patented zone-perforated rear baffle; and static-dissipating construction.

FilterMate Portable Exhauster provides an alternative when ducting to the outside is not feasible. The FilterMate contains an 99.99% efficient, oversized HEPA filter to remove hazardous powders, particulates or vapors from the exhaust air stream, returning filtered air to the environment. A true bag-in/bag-out filter disposal system provides safe and easily accessible replacement of the HEPA filter.

• Conformance: ANSI Z9.5, Modified ASHRAE 110, SEFA 1

• Sash Opening Height: 8.0 in. (20.3 cm)

VEE GEE Scientific digital stem thermometers are ideal for temperature monitoring in essentially any setting: Laboratories, for easily monitoring reagents and liquids in test tubes, beakers, and flasks; Food Processing; Refrigeration; Horticulture; and much more.

DESCRIPTION:
Fiberglass Blowers are ideal for fume hood exhaust systems in moderate to highly corrosive conditions. They are offered in a broad range of capacities from 250 to 3500 CFM at static pressures up to 4.0 in. Fiberglass Blowers are not recommended for use with perchloric acid use.
Features:
• Housings are made from molded fiberglass reinforced polyester for durability and long life
• Impellers are made of injection-molded polypropylene to resist corrosive atmospheres
• Dry powder epoxy-coated base and weather cover provide long life in extreme weather
• Inlet and discharge diameters are sized to receive rigid PVC ducting material directly for easy installation. Blowers are available with 10, 12 and 16 in. inlet/outlet connections.
• Sheaves are adjustable to allow for air volume adjustment
• Blowers operate at low RPMs for quiet operation
• Flow-through vent holes and louvers allow circulation that cools the motor, thus prolonging motor life
• Self-adjusting gravity belt tightener insures consistent performance because belt is held taut by weight of motor. Motor mount keeps the motor in place should the belt ever fail.
• Sound decibel levels for Fiberglass Blowers with 10 in. and 12 in. diameter inlets generally range between 64 and 88 dba, depending on blower size
• Variable exhaust orientation adjusts to eight outlet positions for installation flexibility (vertical discharge is recommended)
• Explosion-proof models have non-sparking polypropylene impellers and UL listed explosion-proof motors for maximum safety
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S Premier Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures, 208-230V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
Protector Premier I-S Laboratory Hoods incorporate a sleek interior with a molded one-piece fiberglass liner, the signature feature of Labconcos leading line of fume hoods since 1961. The one-piece liner of specially-formulated, fiberglass-reinforced polyester offers corrosion and fire resistance and easy clean up. Without seams, the interior has fewer points of deterioration for longer life.

Designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers, Protector Premier I-S Hoods feature integrated sash position blower controls. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

These hoods are suitable for providing personal protection needed for general chemistry applications involving fumes and vapors. They meet the SEFA-1 standard of a low velocity, high performance hood and may be safely operated as low as 60 fpm.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 96 x 31.7 x 59 in.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 660.0 lbs
• Lighting: LED

PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft Echo Hood, 2 Service Fixtures, Solid Walls, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug
• Two pre-plumbed service fixtures for gas and cold water. Components for converting either or both fixtures to air and vacuum are provided. Inlet tubing is not provided
side)

• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Ohaus HB1DG 1 Block Digital Dry Block Heater, 120V
PRODUCT_NAME: Ohaus HB1DG 1 Block Digital Dry Block Heater, 120V
DESCRIPTION:
Designed for applications that require repeatable results and superior temperature stability. These multi-purpose units are ideal for incubation and activation of cultures, enzyme reactions, immunoassays, melting/boiling points, and a wide variety of other laboratory procedures. Integral support rod holder with locking knob accepts optional External Temperature Probe Kit (available separately, Cat. No. 369-10655). Each of the models accepts separate interchangeable modular blocks, accommodating various tube sizes. Efficient heating due to close tube-and-block contact for maximum heat retention. Heaters require OHAUS modular heating blocks for operation. Modular blocks are sold separately (see accessories).

PID temperature control offers a temperature stability as low as +/- 0.1°C with a temperature uniformity as low as +/- 0.1°C. Samples are heated to temperature quickly and accurately. Temperature is adjusted in +/- 0.1°C increments. Touch pad controls with easy-to-read, independent LED displays for temperature, and time. Shows set-point and actual temperature. Timer will display elapsed time or, when programmed to user defined limit, will shut off unit when time reaches zero. Display will show last used settings, even after power has been turned off. Temperature calibration mode allows user to calibrate unit to an external temperature device. Hot warning symbol light is illuminated when the temperature is above 40°C. If the unit exceeds the set temperature by 10°C the unit will automatically stop heating. In timed mode, alarm will sound when time reaches zero and when unit reaches set-point temperature. Units can be run in conditions from 18 to 33°C (64 to 91°F), 20% to 80% relative humidity, non-condensing. Units include a detachable, 3-wire cord and plug.

Specifications:
• Temperature range: Ambient +5°C to 120°C
• Temperature stability @ 37°C: +/-0.1°C
• Uniformity within the block @ 37°C: +/-0.1°C

CAUTION To avoid possible electrical hazard, do not fill well or block with water or other fluids. Units are designed as a dry bath/incubator.

DESCRIPTION:
Hamilton HV, HVP, HVX, HVM, and HVXM valves have a port depth of 5.6 mm (7/32) which is much shorter than the industry standard ports. This design minimizes the dead volume that is trapped in the valve port. To take advantage of this unique feature, a line of short adapters has been designed that will only work with Hamilton valves. These fittings have a 1/4-28 UNF thread connection on one side and either a male luer, female luer, or male luer lock on the other side.

Use tubing assemblies to connect tubing to valves (100psig or less). Use the female luer, male luer, luer lock and barbed fittings to connect syringes, equipment, or other devices to Hamilton valves. Fittings and adapters are constructed of Kel-F material (CTFE), except the male luer lock fittings and swivel union, which are made of Kel-F (CTFE) and metal. Some fittings are offered in two port diameters for fluid flow optimization.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures, 208-230V, 50/60Hz
PRODUCT_NAME: 8 ft. Protector I-S XStream Laboratory Hood, with 2 Service Fixtures, 208-230V, 50/60Hz
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector XStream I-S Laboratory Hood takes containment, safety and energy savings to the extreme. With integrated sash position blower controls, this hood was designed for use with Intelli-Sense Multi-Speed Blowers. As the sash is raised or lowered, sensors alert the blower to change speeds to maintain a safe face velocity. That face velocity is displayed on the factory-installed Guardian™ Digital Airflow Monitor for users peace of mind.

This general chemical, high performance fume hood was independently tested and challenged well beyond the SEFA-1 standards. With a face velocity of 40 fpm and sash fully open, the Protector XStream I-S was subjected to 50 fpm cross drafts, NIH protocol, and tracer gas measurements in the chest of the mannequin. In all scenarios, the Protector XStream I-S allowed 0.00 ppm average level of tracer gas outside the fume hood. Although your safety officer will determine the actual face velocity setting for your laboratory, the ability of this hood to contain under these adverse conditions sets a new standard of safety.

Safety is foremost, but energy savings is equally impressive. Although face velocity is a factor, its the volumetric rate (CFM) that determines the energy consumption. Operating a 6 Protector XStream I-S at 60 fpm face velocity, with the sash in its fully open position, requires only 690 CFM. Regardless of your desired operating face velocity, the Protector XStream I-S yields the lowest required CFM of any hood.

Specifications
• Dimensions (W x D x H): 96 x 37.7 x 59 in.
• Blower Requirements: Remote blower required
• Conformance: ADA, ANSI Z9.5, ASHRAE 110, ASTM E84, CAN/CSA C22.2, CFR 29, NFPA 45, SEFA 1, UL 1805, UL 61010
• Lighting: LED
• Estimated Shipping Weight: 780.0 lbs

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 5 ft Echo Hood, No Fixtures, Solid Walls, 115V
PRODUCT_NAME: 5 ft Echo Hood, No Fixtures, Solid Walls, 115V
DESCRIPTION:
The Protector Echo Filtered Fume Hood requires no ducting and is available in 4, 5, 6 and 8 ft widths. Neutrodine® Unisorb Filtration Technology offers comprehensive molecular filtration. eGuard® communication software offers real-time monitoring on the users phone or computer. From a remote location, data such as usage authorization, filter saturation detection, sash position and temperature may be observed and managed. Erlab-proven Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters are the heart of GFH Filtration Technology.

Benchtop models include a fiberglass panelized liner. Models are available for carbon-only, carbon with acid sensor, carbon with formaldehyde sensor, or HEPA-only filtration. Filters are sold separately.

Features
• Eco-Foil™ air foil with aerodynamic Clean-Sweep™ airflow openings
• Cord-Keeper™ Slots on left and right side of air foil
• Removable front and side panels, and front and interior service access panels for access to plumbing and electrical wiring
• By-pass airflow design
• Glacier white powder-coated steel exterior
• Chemical-resistant, fiberglass-reinforced, composite panel liner
• Pre-wired vapor-proof LED lights
• eGuard2 software communication
• Smart control command module with wifi, Bluetooth and ethernet connectivity
• Factory-installed command module, fan button and light button
• Roughing prefilter
• Built-in exhaust fans to maintain 60 fpm face velocity at 16 in. sash opening height
• Sound pressure of <60 dB(A) with sash at operating height and <48 dB(A) with sash closed
• Sensor package for primary filter breakthrough of solvent and acid fumes, laboratory air quality, sash position, and temperature
• Audible/visual alarms for breakthrough detection, temperature 40° C (104° F), fan failure and high sash position opening. At 60° C (140° F), all fans stop
• Single piece, tempered safety glass vertical-rising sash with cable pulley, sash weight and powder-coated aluminum sash handle and tracks with airflow openings. Sash stop at 16 in. sash opening height. Sash opens to 28 in. high for loading
• Factory-prepared for up to four electrical duplex receptacles and eight service fixtures
• 37.5 in. high sightline from the work surface and header panel
• Power cord with plug

Required Accessories (Not Included)
• Neutrodine® Unisorb Filters (except HEPA only models which require HEPA filters). Number of filters required is determined by the width of the hood
• Work Surface
• Base Cabinet or Stand

Options Available Include
• HEPA filter
• Sash Opening Wing Reduction Kits
• Region-specific electrical plug configurations
• Service fixtures

Compliance
• SEFA 9, DHIII, SEFA 8, Cabinet Surface Finish Tests, Modified ASHRAE 110, ANSI Z9.5-2011, AFNOR NF-X 15-211, ASTM E84-09C, UL Standard 61010-1, CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 61010-1

Specifications
• Airflow Type: Bypass
• Product Subcategory: General Chemistry
• Air foil Type: Eco-Foil
• Blower Requirements: Integral blower included
• Lighting: LED
• Sash Type: Cable and pulley
• Service Fixtures: 0
• Style: Benchtop

PRODUCT_NAME: Lindberg Blue M Box Furnace, Digital Multi-Program, Multi-Segment Programmable Control, Over-Temp Control, Flowmeter Option, 16.4 L
DESCRIPTION:
Utilize the latest technical advances in heating elements, insulation and temperature control integrated into a self-contained cabinet with Thermo Scientific™ Lindberg/Blue M™ LGO Box Furnaces. Furnaces feature proprietary LGO (light gauge overbend) heating elements and Thermo Scientific™ Moldatherm™ insulation for efficient and economical transfer of heat to chamber, with low exterior temperatures. Variable heat-up rate eliminates thermal shock to materials with inherently quick heat up and cool down rates.

Key Features
• Air vent (1 in. dia., top) and air inlet (0.375 in. dia., rear) for inert atmosphere exchange (may experience some leakage at door)
• Self-tuning, digital instrumentation for precise temperature setpoint and display
• Platinel II™ thermocouple for long-term stability
• 0.6 cu. ft. models feature vertical lift door; 2 cu. ft. models feature horizontal side swing door, hot side facing away from operator for protection
• Required power cord and hardwiring not included.

Microprocessor Control
• Microprocessor-based self-tuning PID control (proportional, integral, derivative) provides optimum thermal process, prevents overshoot
• Control panel designed for easy access and maintenance
• Main power ON/OFF switch on control panel
• Adjustable high-limit overtemperature protection
• Simultaneous LED display of actual temperature vs. setpoint
• Can be configured to display temperature in either °C or °F
• Safety door switch interrupts power to heating element when door is opened; protects heating elements and minimizes exposure to end-user
• Removable shelves for versatility
• Moldatherm™ hearthplate supports load and prevents damage due to spillage

Digital, Single-Setpoint Controller
• Single segment, single setpoint, one ramp to setpoint

Digital Single-Program, Multiple-Segment Programmable Controller
• Single program with multiple segments for ramp (up and down) and dwell (timed hold) temperature control

Digital Multiple-Program, Multiple-Segment Programmable Controller
• Available on models with (P) suffix designation
• Multiple programs and segments for ramp (up and down) and dwell (timed hold) temperature control

Overtemperature Control (OTC)†
• Adjustable digital overtemperature control, available on selected models with(B)suffix designation
• Protects furnace and load in the event of primary control circuit failure
• Overrides main controller and shuts off power to furnace if high limit is reached
• Manual reset required for safety
• Operates via magnetic contacts through signal from independent thermocouple

Flowmeter Option (FM) (Inert Atmosphere Only)
• Available on selected models with (FM) designation
• Gas flowmeter, adjustable, located on front control panel
• Adjustable flowrate, range 1.0 to 10.0 cu. ft./hr. standard
• Suitable for inert gas or airflow to chamber
• Allows fresh air exchange for ashing applications Not suitable for combustible or volatile gases

Ordering Information:
Required power cord and hardwiring not included. Optional RS485 Digital Communications Port allows controller to be connected to a PC for remote monitoring and control of the furnace; up to 30 units can be connected to one PC.

Includes
• One two-part shelf (0.6 cu. ft. models have one shelf position at center position; 2.0 cu. ft. models have three shelf positions)

†Specify Option

B for Overtemperature Control (OTC) when ordering.

†U.S. and Canada Sales Only
